children: Former Indonesia central bank Governor Perry Warjiyo on Tuesday said the newly-approved leadership of Bank Indonesia should strengthen its mandate of ensuring stability and supporting growth.
His comment were his first since his surprise resignation in late July. His former senior deputy, Destry Damayanti, was approved by parliament on Tuesday to succeed him as governor.
